content_sections.heading: KVASU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the KVASU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for KVASU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for KVASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Kerala Veterinary and Animal Sciences University (KVASU) for filling temporary positions under a revolving fund project at the Teaching Veterinary Clinical Complex, Pookode, Wayanad, Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in KVASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available across various posts including Laboratory Technician, Office Assistant, and Operation Theatre Attendant under this specific notification advertisement number TVCC/ Pkt/ RF1/ 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application and selection for these posts?
faq.answer: The application and selection process is entirely based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates do not need to submit any prior online applications and can directly attend the interview at the designated venue on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for KVASU Recruitment 2026 is scheduled to be held on 16 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they report on time along with all necessary original and self-attested copies of documents.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligible qualifications for the Laboratory Technician post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Laboratory Technician position must possess a Plus Two or equivalent qualification along with a Diploma in Laboratory Techniques specifically offered by Kerala Veterinary and Animal Sciences University.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for the Office Assistant position?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Office Assistant role must hold a recognized Degree in any faculty from a recognized University or its equivalent qualification. Additional diplomas or computer proficiency are desirable.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Operation Theatre Attendant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Operation Theatre Attendant post will receive a monthly consolidated salary or stipend of ₹ 12,500/- under the terms of the temporary contract agreement.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification released by Kerala Veterinary and Animal Sciences University for these contractual positions, making the interview process completely free of registration charges.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry an application prepared on A4 size white paper with an affixed passport-size photo, brief biodata, along with original and self-attested photocopies of all educational certificates, ID proof, and experience records.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Kerala Veterinary and Animal Sciences University located in Wayanad, Kerala (Pincode: 673576). Candidates should check the detailed notification for specific venue room or department details.
